text: The flat white is the best in the neighbourhood and the staff remember your name.
Quiet corner, fast wifi, and the cinnamon buns sell out for a reason.
Staff sorted out my order mix-up in about a minute, no fuss at all.
Brought my parents here on Sunday and they haven't stopped talking about the scones.
Warm room, warm welcome, and a proper pot of tea.
I work from here two mornings a week. Nobody hurries you, the soup of the day is always good, and the oat milk is on the house if you ask nicely.
Lovely lunch spot. The grilled cheese with the tomato jam is a small masterpiece. It gets loud around noon, so go early.
Coffee was great but my sandwich took twenty-five minutes on a quiet afternoon. The server apologised and brought a free cookie, which helped.
They made a birthday cake for my daughter at short notice and even wrote her name on it in icing. Truly kind people.
Ordered a latte to go and it was lukewarm by the time I reached the car. Would give it another try but the first impression stung.
Best almond croissant I have had outside of Paris. I am not exaggerating. Get there before ten.
Dog friendly patio, friendly staff and a decent cold brew. Parking is a bit tight on Saturdays.
The baristas are patient with a nervous first-timer like me. Asked about every bean on the shelf and got a proper answer.
We hold our book club here every second Thursday. They push two tables together and keep the tea coming without being asked.
Reliable, cosy and the banana bread is excellent. Wish they opened earlier on Sundays.
Honest prices and generous portions. The breakfast plate fed me until dinner.
Nice atmosphere but the music was a bit loud for a conversation. Food was good and the staff were friendly.
Stopped in during a rainstorm and was handed a towel and a hot chocolate before I had even ordered. That is hospitality.
Great spot for a first date. Quiet enough to talk, and the lemon tart is shareable, just about.
Waited at the counter for ten minutes while two staff chatted. Left without ordering. Hopefully an off day.
Cinnamon buns every Saturday are the reason I get out of bed. Thank you for keeping the recipe the same.
